en: A monochrome postcard showing a naval gun or artillery piece mounted on a stand and shield, displayed indoors as an exhibit. Ropes and stanchions surround the piece, and framed items hang on the walls in the background. Along the right edge, vertically printed French text references the International Exhibition of Athens and its naval section. At the bottom center there is a website watermark.
